name: Instalación de MongoDB y Compass
description: MongoDB 8.0 y Compass 1.46.2. Requiere base Ubuntu focal/jammy/noble y arquitectura x86_64.
content:
- name: Detectar base Ubuntu del equipo
  ansible.builtin.shell: . /etc/os-release; printf "%s" "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}"
  register: aula_ubuntu_base
  changed_when: false
- name: Comprobar base Ubuntu compatible
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - aula_ubuntu_base.stdout in ['focal', 'jammy', 'noble']
    fail_msg: Se necesita una base Ubuntu focal, jammy o noble identificable en /etc/os-release.
- name: Comprobar arquitectura de Compass del paquete adjunto
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
    - ansible_facts.architecture == 'x86_64'
    fail_msg: El paquete Compass de esta receta es amd64; se necesita un equipo x86_64.
- name: Instalar dependencias
  apt:
    name:
    - gnupg
    - curl
    - ca-certificates
    state: present
    update_cache: true
- name: Descargar y agregar clave pública de MongoDB
  ansible.builtin.get_url:
    url: https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-8.0.asc
    dest: /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.asc
    mode: '0644'
- name: Convertir clave PGP a keyring
  command: gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.asc
  args:
    creates: /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg
- name: Añadir repositorio de MongoDB
  ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
    repo: deb [arch=amd64,arm64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg]
      https://repo.mongodb.org/apt/ubuntu {{ aula_ubuntu_base.stdout }}/mongodb-org/8.0
      multiverse
    state: present
    filename: mongodb-org-8.0
- name: Instalar gnome-keyring
  apt:
    name: gnome-keyring
    state: present
- name: Instalar MongoDB
  apt:
    name: mongodb-org
    state: present
    update_cache: true
- name: Descargar MongoDB Compass
  get_url:
    url: https://downloads.mongodb.com/compass/mongodb-compass_1.46.2_amd64.deb
    dest: /tmp/mongodb-compass.deb
    mode: '0644'
- name: Instalar MongoDB Compass
  apt:
    deb: /tmp/mongodb-compass.deb
- name: Eliminar paquete .deb descargado
  file:
    path: /tmp/mongodb-compass.deb
    state: absent
- name: Iniciar MongoDB y habilitarlo al arrancar
  ansible.builtin.service:
    name: mongod
    state: started
    enabled: true

ansible.builtin.assert.fail_msg: Se necesita una base Ubuntu focal, jammy o noble identificable en /etc/os-release.
